items.english: to take by, to travel by

items.chinese: 我每天坐火車去學校上課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò huǒchē qù xuéxiào shàngkè.
items.english: I take the train to school for class every day.

items.chinese: 他們想坐火車去花蓮找朋友。
items.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng zuò huǒchē qù Huālián zhǎo péngyǒu.
items.english: They want to take the train to Hualien to visit friends.

items.chinese: 我等一下要跟朋友見面。
items.pinyin: Wǒ děng yíxià yào gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
items.english: I am meeting a friend shortly.

items.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò xiǎng qù nǎlǐ wán?
items.english: Where would you like to go for fun this weekend?

items.chinese: 請問，這個東西中文怎麼說？
items.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè ge dōngxi Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?
items.english: Excuse me, how do you say this thing in Chinese?

items.pinyin: Tā chīfàn chī de hěn màn.

items.chinese: 從我家到學校附近的咖啡店要半個鐘頭。
items.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào fùjìn de kāfēidiàn yào bàn ge zhōngtóu.
items.english: It takes half an hour to get from my home to the café near school.

items.chinese: 我最近比較忙，沒有空去找你。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, méi yǒu kòng qù zhǎo nǐ.
items.english: I have been rather busy recently and have no time to visit you.

items.pinyin: Tā xiě zì xiě de hěn kuài.

items.chinese: 我常在網路上買高鐵車票。
items.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi gāotiě chēpiào.
items.english: I often buy high-speed rail tickets online.

items.chinese: 那家店的牛肉麵非常好吃，你一定要去吃。
items.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de niúròu miàn fēicháng hǎochī, nǐ yídìng yào qù chī.
items.english: The beef noodles at that shop are delicious. You must go and try them.

items.chinese: 我想跟你們去看籃球比賽，但是等一下我得去上課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐmen qù kàn lánqiú bǐsài, dànshì děng yíxià wǒ děi qù shàngkè.
items.english: I want to watch the basketball game with you, but I have to go to class shortly.

items.chinese: 這家店的小籠包又便宜又好吃。
items.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de xiǎolóngbāo yòu piányí yòu hǎochī.
items.english: The soup dumplings at this shop are both inexpensive and delicious.

items.chinese: 我們學校的圖書館又大又舒服，很多學生喜歡去那裡看書。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de túshūguǎn yòu dà yòu shūfú, hěn duō xuéshēng xǐhuan qù nàlǐ kànshū.
items.english: Our school library is both large and comfortable. Many students like reading there.

items.chinese: 這個火車站附近有很多商店。
items.pinyin: Zhè ge huǒchē zhàn fùjìn yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn.
items.english: There are many shops near this train station.

items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou qù yóuyǒng?
items.english: When would you like to go swimming?
Either the morning or the afternoon is fine.

items.chinese: 聽說臺南有不少有名的小吃。
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō Táinán yǒu bù shǎo yǒumíng de xiǎochī.
items.english: I heard that Tainan has quite a few famous snacks.

items.chinese: 我不常坐火車，比較常坐高鐵。
items.pinyin: Wǒ bù cháng zuò huǒchē, bǐjiào cháng zuò gāotiě.
items.english: I do not often take the train. I take high-speed rail more often.

items.chinese: 你常在網路上買東西嗎？
items.pinyin: Nǐ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi dōngxi ma?

items.chinese: 學校裡面有兩家便利商店，真方便。
items.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn, zhēn fāngbiàn.
items.english: There are two convenience stores on campus. It is really convenient.
